snippet.title: V.O.L.T. Survivors - Reveal trailer
snippet.description:
Infestation spreading. Corporation left. Operators stay.

1-4 player sci-fi bullet heaven roguelite. Combine game-breaking attachments, stack elemental mods, turn a starter pistol into a screen-clearing catastrophe. Beat the boss before the swarm beats you.

💥 A unique gun-attachment based upgrade system
👥 Co-op with up to 3 friends, fun interactions
☣️ Traps, events, random objectives
🔧 Permanent skill trees, every mission pays

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4934810/VOLT_Survivors/
Join Discord: https://discord.gg/2ktrmngzXn

#VOLTSurvivors #BulletHeaven #Roguelite #IndieGame #Steam #Coop #roguelike #bullethell #survivorslike #scifigaming
